big_case.notes: Emergency application to stay a final judgment enjoining a presidential executive order on federal election administration (citizenship verification for the federal form), brought by twelve intervenor states alongside a parallel presidential application, months before the 2026 midterms; full-Court referral and amicus interest confirm the stakes. Denial preserved the status quo but the dispute is a major separation-of-powers and elections matter.
